mainEntity.name: When should a business consider pursuing AEO certification?

acceptedAnswer.text: A business should consider pursuing AEO certification if it is heavily involved in international trade, frequently imports or exports goods, or operates within a complex global supply chain. It becomes particularly beneficial if your company faces numerous customs inspections, experiences frequent delays at borders, or seeks to enhance its reputation for security and reliability among trading partners. Proactive pursuit of AEO can also be strategic if your business plans to expand into new international markets or if key partners are already AEO-certified.
acceptedAnswer.description: Businesses heavily involved in international trade, facing customs delays, or seeking enhanced supply chain security and global reputation should consider AEO certification.
